scenes.title: Can redundancy rescue a noisy bit?

sentences.en: Can repeating yourself make a noisy link more reliable?
sentences.zh: 重复自己，能让有噪声的链路更可靠吗？

sentences.en: Send zero as zero zero zero and one as one one one through three independent BSC uses, each with crossover probability zero point one.
sentences.zh: 用三次独立的BSC(0.10)信道使用，把0发成000，把1发成111。

sentences.en: The receiver sees zero one zero. Which original bit should it choose?
sentences.zh: 接收者看到010。它应该选择哪个原始比特？

sentences.en: Majority decoding selects zero. It corrects any one flipped position.
sentences.zh: 多数判决选择0，能够纠正任意一个位置的翻转。

sentences.en: An error now requires at least two of the three positions to flip.
sentences.zh: 现在，至少三个位置中有两个翻转才会出错。

sentences.en: The probability is three times .10 squared times .90, plus .10 cubed: .028.
Error falls from .10 to .028, but the rate is only one information bit per three channel uses.
sentences.zh: 错误率从0.10降到0.028，但速率只有每三次信道使用传一个信息比特。

sentences.en: Can longer blocks make error vanish at a positive rate? A finite repetition example cannot prove that.
sentences.zh: 更长的块能在正速率下让错误趋于零吗？一个有限重复码例子还不能证明这一点。

sentences.en: A length n block code starts with a finite message set.
sentences.zh: 长度为n的分组码从有限消息集合开始。

sentences.en: Write its size as M.
sentences.zh: 将其大小记为M。

sentences.en: A deterministic encoder maps each message to an input sequence of length n.
sentences.zh: 确定性编码器将每条消息映射为长度n的输入序列。

sentences.en: The channel produces a random output sequence of length n.
sentences.zh: 信道产生长度为n的随机输出序列。

sentences.en: A decoder maps each received sequence to a message estimate.
sentences.zh: 译码器将每个接收序列映射为消息估计。

sentences.en: The code rate is log two M divided by n.
sentences.zh: 码率R=(log₂M)/n。

sentences.en: Its unit is information bits per channel use.
sentences.zh: 其单位是每次信道使用的信息比特数。

sentences.en: For message m, define its conditional error probability.
sentences.zh: 对消息m，定义其条件错误概率。

sentences.en: Average error is the mean of these probabilities over messages.
sentences.zh: 平均错误概率是这些条件错误概率对消息的平均。

sentences.en: This convention gives every message equal weight.
sentences.zh: 这种约定给每条消息相同权重。

sentences.en: Maximal error is the largest conditional error among messages.
sentences.zh: 最大错误概率是所有消息条件错误中的最大值。

sentences.en: The maximal value cannot be smaller than the average.
sentences.zh: 最大值不可能小于平均值。

sentences.en: An average criterion can hide a few messages with large conditional error.
sentences.zh: 平均准则可能掩盖少数条件错误很大的消息。

sentences.en: A maximal criterion rules out that disparity.
sentences.zh: 最大错误准则排除了这种差异。

sentences.en: Both criteria are defined using the channel law and decoder.
sentences.zh: 两种准则都由信道概率律和译码器定义。

sentences.en: A maximum a posteriori decoder uses prior message probabilities.
sentences.zh: 最大后验译码器使用消息先验概率。

sentences.en: With uniform messages, maximum a posteriori and maximum likelihood agree.
sentences.zh: 消息均匀时，最大后验与最大似然译码一致。

sentences.en: With nonuniform messages, the prior can change the best decision.
sentences.zh: 消息不均匀时，先验可能改变最优判决。

sentences.en: Use codewords zero zero zero and one one one on a BSC with crossover probability zero point two. Receive zero one one.
sentences.zh: 在BSC(0.20)上使用码字000和111，接收到011。

sentences.en: The likelihoods are .032 versus .128. But the message priors are .90 versus .10.
sentences.zh: 两个似然分别为0.032和0.128，但消息先验分别为0.90和0.10。

sentences.en: Does multiplying by those priors keep or reverse the likelihood decision?
sentences.zh: 乘上这些先验后，原来的似然判决会保留还是反转？

sentences.en: The weighted values are zero point zero two eight eight versus zero point zero one two eight. MAP chooses zero zero zero.
sentences.zh: 加权后分别为0.0288和0.0128。最大后验判决选择000。

sentences.en: This episode first studies deterministic encoders and decoders.
sentences.zh: 本集先研究确定性编码器与译码器。

sentences.en: Random codebooks will be a proof device for finding deterministic codes.
sentences.zh: 随机码本将作为寻找确定码的证明工具。

sentences.en: A code is reliable when its block error probability is small.
sentences.zh: 当分组错误概率较小时，称该码可靠。

sentences.en: Vanishing error refers to a sequence of codes as block length grows.
sentences.zh: 错误趋零是指块长增长时的一列编码。

sentences.en: It is not a zero-error promise for every finite block.
sentences.zh: 这并不保证每个有限块都零错误。

sentences.en: The central question is which rates permit vanishing error.
sentences.zh: 核心问题是哪些码率允许错误概率趋零。

sentences.en: For a discrete memoryless channel, the answer will involve mutual information.
sentences.zh: 对离散无记忆信道，答案将由互信息决定。

sentences.en: First we need a test for whether an input-output pair looks typical.
sentences.zh: 首先需要检验输入输出对是否典型。

sentences.en: The test must distinguish the true pair from an independent wrong codeword.
sentences.zh: 该检验必须区分真实配对与独立错误码字。

sentences.en: Both steps use different probability arguments.
sentences.zh: 这两步分别使用不同的概率论证。

sentences.en: The input and output marginal tests prevent atypical sequences from entering.
sentences.zh: 输入与输出边缘检验排除非典型序列。

sentences.en: The joint test checks compatibility under the channel law.
sentences.zh: 联合检验检查输入输出是否符合信道规律。

sentences.en: Next, define weak joint typicality through three surprisal tests.
sentences.zh: 接下来通过三项自信息检验定义弱联合典型性。

scenes.title: Three surprisal windows control true and wrong pairs

sentences.en: Fix an input distribution P X and a discrete memoryless channel, named letter W.
sentences.zh: 固定输入分布P_X与离散无记忆信道W。

sentences.en: Together they define a joint law P X Y.
sentences.zh: 二者共同定义联合分布P_XY。

sentences.en: Draw n input-output pairs independently from this joint law.
sentences.zh: 从该联合分布独立抽取n组输入输出对。

sentences.en: The weak joint typical set uses three conditions.
sentences.zh: 弱联合典型集由三个条件构成。

sentences.en: First, input sequence surprisal per symbol is near H of X.
sentences.zh: 第一，输入序列每符号自信息接近H(X)。

sentences.en: Its distance from H of X is at most epsilon.
sentences.zh: 它与H(X)的差距至多为ε。

sentences.en: Second, output sequence surprisal per symbol is near H of Y.
sentences.zh: 第二，输出序列每符号自信息接近H(Y)。

sentences.en: Its distance from H of Y is at most epsilon.
sentences.zh: 它与H(Y)的差距至多为ε。

sentences.en: Third, joint sequence surprisal per symbol is near H of X,Y.
sentences.zh: 第三，联合序列每符号自信息接近H(X,Y)。

sentences.en: Its distance from joint entropy is at most epsilon.
sentences.zh: 它与联合熵的差距至多为ε。

sentences.en: These are marginal and joint probability tests, rather than empirical joint-frequency tests.
sentences.zh: 这些是边缘和联合概率检验，并非经验联合频率检验。

sentences.en: Each fair four-bit string passes its marginal test. Does every displayed pair then pass the joint test?
sentences.zh: 每个公平四比特串都通过边缘检验。那么图中的每一对也都能通过联合检验吗？

sentences.en: No. With epsilon .04, the joint test keeps exactly the pairs one bit apart in this four-bit example.
sentences.zh: 不是。在这个四比特例子中，ε=0.04的联合检验恰好只保留相差一位的串对。

sentences.en: The true-pair probability here is zero point four two one eight seven five. Probability approaching one concerns growing block length.
sentences.zh: 这些串对的真实联合概率为0.421875。趋于一的概率结论针对的是不断增长的块长。

sentences.en: For the true pair, each tested surprisal is a sample average.
sentences.zh: 对真实配对，每项自信息检验都是样本平均。

sentences.en: The input surprisal terms are independent with mean H of X.
sentences.zh: 输入自信息项独立，均值为H(X)。

sentences.en: The output marginal sequence is IID with mean surprisal H of Y.
sentences.zh: 输出边缘序列IID，其平均自信息为H(Y)。

sentences.en: Joint pair surprisal terms are IID with mean H of X,Y.
sentences.zh: 联合配对自信息项IID，均值为H(X,Y)。

sentences.en: Zero-probability events occur with probability zero and are ignored.
sentences.zh: 零概率事件发生概率为零，因此忽略。

sentences.en: The weak law makes each test pass with probability approaching one.
sentences.zh: 弱大数定律保证每项检验通过概率趋于一。

sentences.en: A union bound over the three failures shows the true pair is typical with probability approaching one.
sentences.zh: 对三项失败事件用并集界，可知真实配对典型概率趋于一。

sentences.en: Now consider an independently generated wrong input sequence.
sentences.zh: 现在考虑独立生成的错误输入序列。

sentences.en: It is independent of the actual channel output under the random-code ensemble.
sentences.zh: 在随机码本系综下，它独立于实际信道输出。

sentences.en: This is exact independence, not an approximation.
sentences.zh: 这是精确独立，而非近似独立。

sentences.en: The independent pair has distribution P X to n times P Y to n.
sentences.zh: 独立配对的分布为P_X^n乘P_Y^n。

sentences.en: For every marginally typical input, its probability is at most two to negative n times H X minus epsilon.
sentences.zh: 每个边缘典型输入的概率至多为2^(−n(H(X)−ε))。

sentences.en: For every marginally typical output, its probability is at most two to negative n times H Y minus epsilon.
sentences.zh: 每个边缘典型输出的概率至多为2^(−n(H(Y)−ε))。

sentences.en: Their independent product is therefore at most two to negative n times H X plus H Y minus two epsilon.
sentences.zh: 独立乘积因此至多为2^(−n(H(X)+H(Y)−2ε))。

sentences.en: We also need to count possible joint-typical pairs.
sentences.zh: 还需计算可能的联合典型配对数量。

sentences.en: Each joint-typical pair has probability at least two to negative n times H X,Y plus epsilon.
sentences.zh: 每个联合典型配对的概率至少为2^(−n(H(X,Y)+ε))。

sentences.en: All such joint probabilities sum to at most one.
sentences.zh: 所有这些联合概率之和至多为一。

sentences.en: Hence the set contains at most two to n times H X,Y plus epsilon pairs.
sentences.zh: 因此该集合至多含2^(n(H(X,Y)+ε))个配对。

sentences.en: Multiply this count by the largest independent-pair probability.
sentences.zh: 将该计数乘以独立配对概率的上界。

sentences.en: The result is at most two to negative n times the quantity mutual information minus three epsilon.
sentences.zh: 结果至多为2^(−n(I(X;Y)−3ε))。

sentences.en: Here I equals H X plus H Y minus H X,Y.
sentences.zh: 这里I(X;Y)=H(X)+H(Y)−H(X,Y)。

sentences.en: This bounds the chance that one independent wrong codeword passes all tests.
sentences.zh: 这就界定了一个独立错误码字通过全部检验的概率。

sentences.en: The true pair used a law of large numbers instead.
sentences.zh: 真实配对则使用大数定律论证。

sentences.en: That distinction powers the random-coding proof.
sentences.zh: 这一区别支撑随机编码证明。

sentences.en: Next, union-bound the wrong candidates in a random codebook.
sentences.zh: 接下来对随机码本中的错误候选使用并集界。

scenes.title: One transmitted pair plus a union bound

sentences.en: Fix an input distribution P X with mutual information I.
sentences.zh: 固定输入分布P_X，其互信息记为I。

sentences.en: Choose a positive target rate R strictly below I.
sentences.zh: 选择满足0<R<I的目标速率R。

sentences.en: For block length n, set M to the integer floor of two to n R.
sentences.zh: 块长为n时，令M=⌊2^(nR)⌋。

sentences.en: The realized rate R n equals log two M divided by n.
sentences.zh: 实际码率Rₙ=(log₂M)/n。

sentences.en: As n grows, R n tends to R.
sentences.zh: n增大时，Rₙ趋于R。

sentences.en: Generate each of the M codewords independently using P X to n.
sentences.zh: 按照P_X^n独立生成M个码字。

sentences.en: Transmit a uniform message through the DMC. Does this displayed output identify a unique typical candidate?
sentences.zh: 通过DMC发送均匀消息。图中的输出能唯一确定一个典型候选吗？

sentences.en: The decoder seeks a unique jointly typical codeword. Here two qualify, so this possible book fails the test.
sentences.zh: 译码器寻找唯一的联合典型码字。这里有两个候选符合，因此这本可能的码表未通过检验。

sentences.en: If none or several qualify, choose a fixed default message and count a test failure.
sentences.zh: 若没有或有多个候选通过，就选定默认消息，并计为检验失败。

sentences.en: An error can occur because the true pair is not typical.
sentences.zh: 真实配对不典型可能造成错误。

sentences.en: Call this probability A sub n.
sentences.zh: 将该事件概率记为aₙ。

sentences.en: The weak law gives A sub n tending to zero.
sentences.zh: 弱大数定律给出aₙ趋于零。

sentences.en: An error can also occur when a wrong codeword is jointly typical.
sentences.zh: 错误码字联合典型也可能造成错误。

sentences.en: Fix which message was transmitted, while retaining the random-code ensemble.
sentences.zh: 固定所发消息的编号，同时保留随机码本系综。

sentences.en: Every other random codeword is independent of the actual output under that ensemble.
sentences.zh: 在该系综下，每个其他随机码字都独立于实际输出。

sentences.en: Averaging over that wrong codeword and output gives the preceding joint-typicality bound.
sentences.zh: 对该错误码字与输出共同取平均，得到上一章的联合典型概率界。

sentences.en: There are M minus one wrong candidates.
sentences.zh: 错误候选共有M−1个。

sentences.en: The union bound sums their probabilities.
sentences.zh: 并集界将这些概率相加。

sentences.en: Average over messages, channel outputs, and random codebooks.
sentences.zh: 对消息、信道输出及随机码本取平均。

sentences.en: Expected average error is at most A sub n plus M minus one times that bound.
sentences.zh: 期望平均错误至多为aₙ+(M−1)乘该概率界。

sentences.en: Since M is at most two to n R, wrong-candidate confusion is bounded by two to negative n Delta.
sentences.zh: 由于M≤2^(nR)，错误候选混淆概率至多为2^(−nΔ)。

sentences.en: Choose epsilon positive so Delta, equal to I minus R minus three epsilon, stays positive.
sentences.zh: 选择ε>0，使Δ=I−R−3ε保持为正。

sentences.en: Then the exponent gap is positive.
sentences.zh: 这样指数间隔为正。

sentences.en: Thus ensemble-average error tends to zero.
sentences.zh: 因此系综平均错误趋于零。

sentences.en: At each n, some deterministic codebook has error no greater than its ensemble mean.
sentences.zh: 对每个n，都存在错误不超过系综均值的确定码本。

sentences.en: Otherwise every codebook would exceed the mean.
sentences.zh: 否则每个码本都超过其平均值。

sentences.en: This proves existence of a good codebook.
sentences.zh: 这证明了好码本的存在。

sentences.en: It does not claim every random codebook is good.
sentences.zh: 这并不声称每个随机码本都好。

sentences.en: For any input law, rates below its mutual information are achievable with vanishing average error.
sentences.zh: 对任意输入分布，低于其互信息的速率可实现平均错误趋零。

sentences.en: Maximizing over input laws gives rates below channel capacity.
sentences.zh: 对输入分布最大化，便得到所有低于信道容量的速率。

sentences.en: A rate of zero is trivially achievable by sending one message.
sentences.zh: 零速率可通过只发送一条消息而平凡实现。

sentences.en: Next, convert average error control into maximal error control.
sentences.zh: 接下来将平均错误控制转为最大错误控制。

scenes.title: Remove a vanishing fraction of bad messages

sentences.en: Take a length n code with average conditional error eta.
sentences.zh: 取一个平均条件错误为η的长度n码。

sentences.en: Assume eta lies strictly between zero and one for the moment.
sentences.zh: 暂时假设0<η<1。

sentences.en: Set the bad-message threshold to square root eta.
sentences.zh: 将坏消息阈值设为√η。

sentences.en: Call a message bad when its error exceeds the threshold. What fraction can be bad?
sentences.zh: 条件错误率超过阈值的消息称为坏消息。坏消息比例最多能有多大？

sentences.en: The average error is at least the bad fraction times the threshold.
sentences.zh: 平均错误至少等于坏消息比例乘以阈值。

sentences.en: Therefore the bad fraction is at most square root eta.
sentences.zh: 因此坏消息比例至多为√η。

sentences.en: Delete all bad messages and retain the others.
sentences.zh: 删除所有坏消息，保留其余消息。

sentences.en: At least M times one minus square root eta messages remain.
sentences.zh: 至少保留M(1−√η)条消息。

sentences.en: Every retained message had conditional error at most square root eta.
sentences.zh: 每条保留消息的条件错误至多为√η。

sentences.en: Keep each retained message’s original correct decoding region.
sentences.zh: 保留每条保留消息原有的正确译码区域。

sentences.en: Reassign outputs of deleted messages to any one retained message.
sentences.zh: 将原先分给已删消息的输出，重新分给任意一条保留消息。

sentences.en: This does not shrink any retained correct region.
sentences.zh: 这样不会缩小任何保留消息的正确区域。

sentences.en: So no retained message’s error probability increases.
sentences.zh: 因此保留消息的错误概率不会增加。

sentences.en: The new maximal error is at most square root eta.
sentences.zh: 新码的最大错误至多为√η。

sentences.en: The retained rate satisfies R prime at least R plus log two of one minus square root eta divided by n.
sentences.zh: 保留码率满足R′≥R+log₂(1−√η)/n。

sentences.en: The added term is a vanishing rate loss when eta tends to zero.
sentences.zh: 当η趋于零时，新增项对应消失的码率损失。

sentences.en: If eta equals zero, delete nothing.
sentences.zh: 若η=0，则无需删除任何消息。

sentences.en: Average-error achievability below capacity follows from random coding.
sentences.zh: 容量以下的平均错误可达性由随机编码得到。

sentences.en: Expurgation then gives maximal-error achievability at the same limiting rates.
sentences.zh: 随后剔除法在相同极限速率下给出最大错误可达性。

sentences.en: Conversely, maximal error always dominates average error.
sentences.zh: 反过来，最大错误始终不小于平均错误。

sentences.en: Thus average and maximal error capacities agree for a finite DMC.
sentences.zh: 因此有限DMC的平均错误容量与最大错误容量相同。

sentences.en: No symmetry of the channel was used.
sentences.zh: 此处没有使用信道对称性。

sentences.en: This is an asymptotic conversion, not equality for every finite code.
sentences.zh: 这是渐近转换，并非每个有限码都相等。

sentences.en: The argument assumes uniform averaging when defining the starting average error.
sentences.zh: 该论证假设初始平均错误按均匀消息定义。

sentences.en: Next, the Fano bound supplies the rate converse.
sentences.zh: 接下来由Fano界得到速率逆向定理。

scenes.title: Single-letter capacity bounds every reliable code

sentences.en: Consider a deterministic length n code with M equiprobable messages.
sentences.zh: 考虑一个有M条等概率消息的确定性长度n码。

sentences.en: Let J denote the random message, and M at least two the number of possible messages.
sentences.zh: 用J表示随机消息，用M≥2表示消息数。

sentences.en: Let P sub e denote the average block error probability.
sentences.zh: 令P_e表示其平均分组错误概率。

sentences.en: Fano’s inequality gives H of J given Y n at most one plus P sub e times log two of M minus one.
sentences.zh: Fano不等式给出H(J|Yⁿ)≤1+P_e log₂(M−1)。

sentences.en: Since entropy of J is log two M, information is at least log M minus that bound.
sentences.zh: 消息熵为log₂M，因此互信息至少为log₂M减去该上界。

sentences.en: Fano gives I of J and Y n at least log M times one minus P e, less one.
sentences.zh: Fano给出I(J;Yⁿ)≥(1−P_e)log₂M−1。

sentences.en: The deterministic encoder maps J to X n.
sentences.zh: 确定性编码器将J映射为Xⁿ。

sentences.en: The memoryless channel then generates Y n from X n.
sentences.zh: 随后无记忆信道根据Xⁿ生成Yⁿ。

sentences.en: This forms the Markov chain J to X n to Y n.
sentences.zh: 这构成Markov链J→Xⁿ→Yⁿ。

sentences.en: Data processing bounds I of J and Y n by I of X n and Y n.
sentences.zh: 数据处理不等式给出I(J;Yⁿ)≤I(Xⁿ;Yⁿ)。

sentences.en: Expand the latter as H of Y n minus H of Y n given X n.
sentences.zh: 将后者展开为H(Yⁿ)−H(Yⁿ|Xⁿ)。

sentences.en: Output entropy subadditivity gives H of Y n at most the sum of H of Y i.
sentences.zh: 输出熵次可加性给出H(Yⁿ)≤ΣᵢH(Yᵢ)。

sentences.en: Memorylessness factors the conditional output law given the input sequence.
sentences.zh: 无记忆性使给定输入序列后的条件输出分布因子化。

sentences.en: Therefore H of Y n given X n equals the sum of H of Y i given X i.
sentences.zh: 因此H(Yⁿ|Xⁿ)=ΣᵢH(Yᵢ|Xᵢ)。

sentences.en: Combining these yields I of X n and Y n at most the sum of I of X i and Y i.
sentences.zh: 合并两式得I(Xⁿ;Yⁿ)≤ΣᵢI(Xᵢ;Yᵢ)。

sentences.en: Each term uses the same single-use channel W.
sentences.zh: 每一项使用同一个单次信道W。

sentences.en: Let P bar be the average of the n input marginals.
sentences.zh: 令P̅为n个输入边缘分布的平均。

sentences.en: Mutual information is concave in the input law for a fixed channel.
sentences.zh: 固定信道时，互信息关于输入分布凹。

sentences.en: Therefore the sum of the n terms is at most n times I of P bar and W.
sentences.zh: 因此n项之和至多为nI(P̅,W)。

sentences.en: That is at most n C by the capacity definition.
sentences.zh: 根据容量定义，它又至多为nC。

sentences.en: Thus log M times one minus P sub e, less one, is at most n times C.
sentences.zh: 因此(1−P_e)log₂M−1≤nC。

sentences.en: The rate R n is log two M divided by n.
sentences.zh: 码率Rₙ=(log₂M)/n。

sentences.en: Rearranging gives R n at most C plus one over n, all divided by one minus P sub e.
sentences.zh: 整理得到Rₙ≤(C+1/n)/(1−P_e)。

sentences.en: As the error probability tends to zero, the upper bound tends to C.
sentences.zh: 当P_e趋于零时，该上界趋于C。

sentences.en: Divide by n and let block error tend to zero.
sentences.zh: 两边除以n，并令分组错误趋于零。

sentences.en: Every reliable code sequence then has limiting upper rate at most C.
sentences.zh: 于是每一列可靠编码的极限上码率至多为C。

sentences.en: This proof uses Fano, data processing, output entropy subadditivity, and memorylessness.
sentences.zh: 证明分别使用Fano、数据处理、输出熵次可加性与无记忆性。

sentences.en: Concavity performs the final single-letter averaging step.
sentences.zh: 最后的单字母平均步骤依赖互信息凹性。

sentences.en: Together with achievability, this identifies capacity as the reliable-rate boundary.
sentences.zh: 结合可达性，这确定了可靠传输速率边界为容量。

sentences.en: This converse uses no feedback; inputs are fixed before outputs arrive.
sentences.zh: 该逆向证明无反馈，输入在收到输出前已确定。

sentences.en: Next, combine source compression and channel coding.
sentences.zh: 接下来结合信源压缩与信道编码。

scenes.title: Compare source bits with channel information budget

sentences.en: Begin with an IID finite-alphabet source of entropy H per symbol.
sentences.zh: 先考虑每符号熵为H的有限字母IID信源。

sentences.en: Choose a source-code rate H plus delta for these m symbols.
sentences.zh: 为这m个符号选择H+δ的信源码率。

sentences.en: This requires at most about two to m times H plus delta messages.
sentences.zh: 这至多需要约2^(m(H+δ))条压缩消息。

sentences.en: Use n times of a DMC with capacity C.
sentences.zh: 使用容量为C的DMC共n次。

sentences.en: Reliable channel coding supports message counts below roughly two to n C.
sentences.zh: 可靠信道编码支持低于约2^(nC)的消息数量。

sentences.en: A strict inequality leaves room for finite-block margins.
sentences.zh: 严格不等式为有限块长误差留出裕量。

sentences.en: Choose delta positive and smaller than channel capacity.
sentences.zh: 选择满足0<δ<C的裕量δ。

sentences.en: Require m times the sum H plus delta to be below n times the difference C minus delta.
sentences.zh: 要求m(H+δ)<n(C−δ)。

sentences.en: Source coding then makes its block error probability vanish.
sentences.zh: 信源编码由此使分组错误趋于零。

sentences.en: Choose a channel code for the compressed messages at rate below C.
sentences.zh: 为压缩消息选择低于C的信道码。

sentences.en: Use a maximal-error channel code for this step.
sentences.zh: 这一步使用最大错误信道码。

sentences.en: The compressed messages need not be equiprobable.
sentences.zh: 压缩消息不必等概率。

sentences.en: A maximal-error bound controls every message distribution.
sentences.zh: 最大错误界控制任意消息分布。

sentences.en: An end-to-end error requires source failure or channel failure.
sentences.zh: 端到端错误要求信源译码失败或信道译码失败。

sentences.en: The total error is at most the sum of those two probabilities.
sentences.zh: 总错误至多为这两种错误概率之和。

sentences.en: Now extend from an IID source to a stationary ergodic finite-alphabet source.
sentences.zh: 现在将IID信源推广到平稳遍历有限字母信源。

sentences.en: Its block entropy divided by m tends to H bar.
sentences.zh: 其块熵除以m趋于H̅。

sentences.en: E05 gives this source an asymptotic equipartition property.
sentences.zh: E05已给出该信源的渐近等分性质。

sentences.en: Source coding rates can approach H bar asymptotically.
sentences.zh: 渐近地，信源编码速率可趋近H̅。

sentences.en: Require m times the sum H bar plus delta below n times the difference C minus delta.
sentences.zh: 要求m(H̅+δ)<n(C−δ)。

sentences.en: Keep a positive margin to select both long-block codes reliably.
sentences.zh: 保留正裕量，以便可靠选取两个长块编码。

sentences.en: With m over n tending to a finite positive rho, every strict inequality rho H bar below C is achievable.
sentences.zh: 若m/n趋于有限正数ρ，则每个严格满足ρH̅<C的比率均可达。

sentences.en: The IID special case replaces H bar by H.
sentences.zh: IID特例中以H替代H̅。

sentences.en: The converse also covers codes that jointly map source blocks to channel blocks.
sentences.zh: 逆向证明也适用于直接将信源块映为信道块的联合码。

sentences.en: For the converse, let U m be the source block over alphabet size K.
sentences.zh: 反向证明中，令Uᵐ为字母表大小K上的信源块。

sentences.en: For the converse, a deterministic nonfeedback joint encoder produces a length-n channel input sequence.
sentences.zh: 反向证明中，确定性无反馈联合编码器输出长度n的信道输入序列。

sentences.en: For K at least two, Fano bounds the conditional entropy by one plus P e m log K.
sentences.zh: K≥2时，Fano界定条件熵至多为1+P_emlog₂K。

sentences.en: The deterministic nonfeedback encoder gives U m to X n to Y n.
sentences.zh: 确定性无反馈编码器形成Uᵐ→Xⁿ→Yⁿ。

sentences.en: The source-block mutual information is at most n C for a DMC.
sentences.zh: DMC上的信源块互信息至多为nC。

sentences.en: Decompose H of U m into that information plus conditional entropy.
sentences.zh: 将H(Uᵐ)分解为该互信息与条件熵。

sentences.en: Thus H of U m is at most n times C, plus one, plus P sub e times m times log K.
sentences.zh: 因此H(Uᵐ)≤nC+1+P_emlog₂K。

sentences.en: Divide by n and take m and n large with m over n tending to rho.
sentences.zh: 两边除以n，并令m、n增大且m/n趋于ρ。

sentences.en: Vanishing error and H of U m over m tending to H bar yield rho H bar at most C.
sentences.zh: 错误趋零且H(Uᵐ)/m趋于H̅，得到ρH̅≤C。

sentences.en: Strict inequality is achievable; exceeding the necessary bound is impossible.
sentences.zh: 严格不等式保证可达；超过必要上界则不可能。

sentences.en: These arguments alone do not decide reliability at the equality boundary.
sentences.zh: 仅凭这些论证，不能判定等号边界处能否可靠传输。

sentences.en: This is a separation statement under the stated source and channel assumptions.
sentences.zh: 这就是在所述信源与信道假设下的分离结论。

sentences.en: It does not assert finite-delay optimality.
sentences.zh: 它不声称有限时延下仍然最优。

sentences.en: A one-symbol source alphabet is deterministic and needs no compression converse.
sentences.zh: 单符号信源字母表对应确定信源，无需压缩逆向证明。

sentences.en: Next, test whether causal feedback changes the DMC capacity.
sentences.zh: 接下来检验因果反馈是否改变DMC容量。

scenes.chapter: Feedback does not increase DMC capacity
scenes.title: Condition on past outputs one use at a time

sentences.en: Let J be a uniform message among M choices, with noiseless causal feedback.
sentences.zh: 令J为M种取值上的均匀消息，反馈无噪声且因果。

sentences.en: At time i, the encoder chooses X i as a function of J and past outputs.
sentences.zh: 时刻i，编码器根据J与过去输出选择Xᵢ。

sentences.en: Write X i equals f i of J and Y one through Y i minus one.
sentences.zh: 记Xᵢ=fᵢ(J,Y₁,…,Yᵢ₋₁)。

sentences.en: The feedback encoder is causal because X i uses no future output.
sentences.zh: 反馈编码器具有因果性，因为Xᵢ不使用未来输出。

sentences.en: The decoder estimates J from all outputs. Can this causal feedback raise the DMC capacity?
sentences.zh: 译码器根据所有输出估计J。这种因果反馈能提高DMC容量吗？

sentences.en: Fano gives I of J and Y n at least log M times one minus P e, less one.
sentences.zh: Fano给出I(J;Yⁿ)≥(1−P_e)log₂M−1。

sentences.en: Expand this mutual information by the chain rule.
sentences.zh: 用链式法则展开该互信息。

sentences.en: I of J and Y n is the sum of I of J and Y i given past outputs.
sentences.zh: I(J;Yⁿ)=ΣᵢI(J;Yᵢ|Yⁱ⁻¹)。

sentences.en: Each term equals H of Y i given its past minus H of Y i given J and its past.
sentences.zh: 每项等于H(Yᵢ|过去)−H(Yᵢ|J,过去)。

sentences.en: The first entropy is at most the unconditional H of Y i.
sentences.zh: 第一项至多为无条件熵H(Yᵢ)。

sentences.en: Given J and past outputs, the causal encoder fixes X i.
sentences.zh: 给定J和过去输出后，因果编码器确定Xᵢ。

sentences.en: The memoryless channel then draws Y i using only W given X i.
sentences.zh: 无记忆信道随后只按W(·|Xᵢ)产生Yᵢ。

sentences.en: Therefore H of Y i given J and past equals H of Y i given X i.
sentences.zh: 因此H(Yᵢ|J,过去)=H(Yᵢ|Xᵢ)。

sentences.en: The conditional past does not change the current transition law.
sentences.zh: 给定过去不会改变当前转移律。

sentences.en: Each chain-rule term is consequently at most I of X i and Y i.
sentences.zh: 因此每个链式项至多为I(Xᵢ;Yᵢ)。

sentences.en: That single-use mutual information is at most C.
sentences.zh: 该单次互信息至多为C。

sentences.en: Summing over all n channel uses bounds I of J and Y n by n times C.
sentences.zh: 对n次使用求和得I(J;Yⁿ)≤nC。

sentences.en: Fano then gives the same converse rate bound as without feedback.
sentences.zh: Fano不等式由此给出与无反馈时相同的逆向速率界。

sentences.en: For achievability, the encoder may simply ignore feedback.
sentences.zh: 在可达性证明中，编码器可以直接忽略反馈。

sentences.en: The nonfeedback code already achieves every rate below C.
sentences.zh: 无反馈编码已能达到所有低于C的速率。

sentences.en: Thus noiseless causal feedback does not change DMC capacity.
sentences.zh: 因此无噪声因果反馈不改变DMC容量。

sentences.en: The proof conditions on the output past at each time.
sentences.zh: 证明在每个时刻都对输出过去进行条件化。

sentences.en: It does not assert a whole-block Markov chain from J through X n to Y n.
sentences.zh: 它没有声称整块存在J→Xⁿ→Yⁿ的Markov链。

sentences.en: Feedback makes X i depend on past channel outputs.
sentences.zh: 有反馈时，Xᵢ依赖过去信道输出。

sentences.en: Feedback may still affect delay, error exponents, or coding strategies.
sentences.zh: 反馈仍可能影响时延、错误指数或编码策略。

sentences.en: Those effects do not alter the capacity conclusion proved here.
sentences.zh: 这些影响不改变此处证明的容量结论。

sentences.en: The argument is specific to a memoryless channel.
sentences.zh: 该论证针对无记忆信道。

sentences.en: Channels with memory require a separate analysis.
sentences.zh: 有记忆信道需要另行分析。

sentences.en: The chain rule keeps the causal dependence visible.
sentences.zh: 链式法则使因果依赖始终显式可见。

sentences.en: Next, continuous alphabets require densities and careful units.
sentences.zh: 下一集转向连续字母表，需要密度与谨慎的单位处理。
